blocker.details: A fresh external comparison was run against both the accepted base ec05167bd7bcb7be874af48fe33d6edb71492516 and the local unpublished commit 199e1b1a5f3854934a08727f2846e028c065c5cb under the same toolchain, authenticated runner bytes, command contract, and non-worktree full-checkout conditions. Both inventory runs discovered exactly 1322 tests with identical test-name hashes, proving the 1309 baseline delta is not caused by the local source change. The exact shell delta between the two commits is only crates/shell/src/execution/host_inbox_materialization.rs, and the targeted retained-worker test function is unchanged at the same source location in both commits. Repeated focused serial and parallel reruns of execution::agent_runtime::retained_worker_runtime::tests::queued_promotion_persists_no_request_prompt_payload_or_diagnostic_preimage fail identically at both commits because a nested admission_head_subprocess_worker path lacks an explicitly bound trace context before global init_trace. Authenticated wall attempts at both commits and in both modes all land in the same 1322/1276/46/0 bucket with the same failure-name and normalized-signature hashes, but every wall provenance record is eligible=false with ineligibility_reasons [evidence_write_failed, mount_teardown_failed]. The original external classifier completed the evidence runs and then crashed while assembling its own summary, so this replacement artifact was written from the finished external evidence set without touching the task checkout.
